verdict.rationale: First-party docs establish modular building blocks: declarative, self-contained components with scoped CSS, plus .svelte.js/.svelte.ts modules for reusable reactive logic and sharing state across the app. The dependency-injection half rests only on a community report praising Svelte's Context system for sharing state, with no first-party documentation of how injection works. Missing for 10: first-party docs of a context/DI API (providing and consuming dependencies through the component tree), examples of injection patterns, hands-on corroboration beyond a single comment.
